Canada.label: Canada
Canada.headline: TSX drops as bond yields surge and rate‑hike expectations pressure markets
Canada.why: Higher Canadian bond yields and growing belief that the Bank of Canada will raise rates pushed the index lower, while weakness in several sectors (telecom, utilities, industrials, financials, metal miners) and a 3.1% inflation reading added further downside pressure.
